name: Agent
description: An AI agent, such as Claude Code with Lathe's plugin, that writes records and code on the Owner's behalf, only through the command layer (the `lathe` command or the MCP tools), never by editing data files by hand.

name: Owner
description: The person who decides what a product is for, writes and checks its spec alongside the Agents, reviews their work, and approves merges, standards and publishing.

name: Reader
description: Anyone who opens the web or desktop app to read and navigate a spec, such as a teammate or the Owner, changing no records.
